violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Establishment must train employees as Food Safety Managers. Establishment is to register Food Safety Manager with RIDOH CFP. New Violation. Correct By: 12/23/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the blower fans in the walk in cooler have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. NFCS must be maintained. Establishment is to clean blower fan guards. New Violation. Correct By: 09/25/2026

The walk in cooler was observed with an excess of ice build up. Condensate drainage and other nonsewage liquids must drain into a drain. Establishment is to remove ice build up. New Violation. Correct By: 09/25/2026

The door to the outside, located in the cafeteria, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 04/10/2026
The steam hot hold unit located in the kitchen area was not in good repair. Equipment must be maintained in good condition or removed from establishment New Violation. Correct By: 04/10/2026

The floor in the storage closet has an accumulation of soil residue, rodent droppings and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Establishment is to clean and sanitize any and all droppings using appropriate means of cleaning and sanitizing. Establishment is to continue to work with pest control to eliminate rodent activity. New Violation. Correct By: 04/10/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/10/2024
